$comment: Machine-readable event spec, schema v2. Validated by every contract's test_events.rs through tools/event-spec; consumed by the bindings package. See docs/events.md.

conventions.topics: (Symbol name, u32 schema_version, primary key...). `topics` below lists only the primary keys after the first two.
conventions.data: A #[contracttype] struct, encoded as an ScMap keyed by field name. `data` names a struct in the contract's `types` (or in `shared.types`).
conventions.types: address, symbol, bool, u32, u64, i128, bytes32, bytes, string, val (any), vec<T>, map<K,V>, option<T>, or a name in `types`.

shared.description: Framework events from zenith-common, emitted by every contract that uses the migration or upgrade framework (see each contract's shared_events).

events.name: schema_migrated
events.state: A migration step finished: the stored schema version is now `to`.

events.name: migration_progress
events.state: A paginated step stopped at `cursor`: the migration is in progress (state-changing entrypoints are closed) until `migrate_batch` finishes it.

events.name: upgrade_multisig_pinned
events.state: The multisig trusted by `upgrade_via_multisig` / `migrate_via_multisig` is now `multisig`.

events.name: upgrade_proposed
events.state: `wasm_hash` is allowlisted and installable from `not_before`.

events.name: upgrade_cancelled
events.state: `wasm_hash` was removed from the allowlist without being installed.

events.name: upgraded
events.state: The contract now runs `wasm_hash` (its allowlist entry is consumed). The post-upgrade guard is up: user-facing entrypoints are closed until `upgrade_checked`.

events.name: upgrade_checked
events.state: The post-upgrade self-check passed on `wasm_hash`: the guard is down and entrypoints are open.

events.name: upgrade_check_failed
events.state: The post-upgrade self-check failed with error `reason`: the guard stays up (the contract is effectively paused) until a later check passes or another wasm is installed.

events.name: initialized
events.state: The governor is live with these parameters; `timelock` executes passed proposals. Each parameter is also announced by a `param_set`.

events.name: proposal_created
events.state: Creates proposal `id` (state `Pending`) with these actions. Voting opens on the ledger after `snapshot` (`Active`) and closes after `deadline`; at that point it is `Succeeded` if for + abstain >= quorum(snapshot) and for > against, else `Defeated`. These transitions follow from ledger progression and have no event.

events.name: vote_cast
events.state: `voter` voted `support` (0 Against, 1 For, 2 Abstain) with `weight` (their power at the snapshot). The proposal's tallies are now `for_votes` / `against_votes` / `abstain_votes`.

events.name: proposal_queued
events.state: Proposal `id` moves from `Succeeded` to `Queued`: the timelock can execute it from `eta` until its grace period ends (then `Expired`). `Executed` is the timelock's own event.

events.name: proposal_canceled
events.state: Proposal `id` moves to `Canceled`. If `was_queued`, its timelock operation was cancelled too.

events.name: param_set
events.state: Governance parameter `name` (`voting_delay`, `voting_period`, `quorum_bps` or `proposal_threshold`) is now `value`.

events.name: grant_created
events.state: Creates grant `grant_id`, funded with `total` of `token` pulled from `funder`. Milestone `i` is `Pending` with amount `amounts[i]`, deadline `deadlines[i]` and no approvals.

events.name: milestone_submitted
events.state: Milestone `idx` moves from `Pending` to `Submitted` with `evidence_hash`.

events.name: milestone_approved
events.state: `reviewer` approved milestone `idx`; it now has `approvals` of `quorum`. Reaching quorum is followed by `milestone_released` in the same call.

events.name: milestone_released
events.state: Milestone `idx` moves to `Released`: `amount` was paid to `grantee`.

events.name: funds_reclaimed
events.state: Every milestone index in `milestones` moves to `Reclaimed`; their sum, `amount`, was returned to `funder`.

events.name: initialized
events.state: The pool is live at epoch 0 with no assets: `admin` governs, `keeper` writes options into `market` with `asset` collateral, up to `max_utilization_bps`.

events.name: keeper_set
events.state: The keeper is now `keeper`.

events.name: max_utilization_set
events.state: The pool-wide utilization cap is now `max_utilization_bps`.

events.name: series_cap_set
events.state: Series `series_id` may hold up to `max_collateral` of the pool's collateral; zero de-lists it.

events.name: liabilities_marked
events.state: The keeper's mark of open-position liabilities (informational, for `share_price`) is now `expected_liabilities`. Reset to zero, without an event, when the last position is reclaimed.

events.name: deposit_queued
events.state: `user` queued `amount` for conversion when `epoch` is processed; their ticket for that epoch is now `ticket` and the epoch's pending deposits `pending_deposits`.

events.name: withdraw_queued
events.state: `shares` left `user`'s balance (now `share_balance`) and are queued for redemption at `epoch`'s price; their ticket is now `ticket`, the epoch's pending shares `pending_withdraw_shares`.

events.name: claimed
events.state: `user`'s tickets from processed epochs settled: `shares` credited (balance now `share_balance`) and `assets` paid out. Settled tickets are removed.

events.name: option_written
events.state: The pool wrote position `position_id` in `series_id`, locking `collateral` and receiving `premium`. Pool `idle` and `locked` are now as given.

events.name: collateral_reclaimed
events.state: Position `position_id` settled: `returned` of its `collateral` came back. It leaves the open-position list; pool `idle` and `locked` are now as given.

events.name: epoch_processed
events.state: Epoch `epoch` closed at `total_assets` / `total_shares`: its queued deposits and withdrawals converted at that price (the conversion is also stored as `EpochResult(epoch)`), and epoch `epoch + 1` opened. Pool `idle` and total shares are now `idle` / `total_shares_after`.

lp_token.standard: SEP-41. The approve/transfer/mint/burn events keep the standard SEP-41 layout (no schema-version topic) so wallets and indexers recognize them.

events.name: initialized
events.state: The share token is live: only `pool` may mint; balances start at zero.

events.name: approve
events.state: `spender` may move up to `amount` (data.0) of `from`'s balance until ledger `expiration_ledger` (data.1), replacing any earlier allowance. SEP-41.

events.name: transfer
events.state: `amount` moves from `from` to `to` (also emitted by `transfer_from`, which additionally reduces the spender's allowance). SEP-41.

events.name: mint
events.state: `amount` new shares are created for `to` by the pool (`admin`). SEP-41.

events.name: burn
events.state: `amount` of `from`'s shares are destroyed (also emitted by `burn_from`). SEP-41.

events.name: initialized
events.state: The multisig is live with these signers and weights, signer-set epoch 0 and no actions.

events.name: registered
events.state: Action `action_id` enters the registry as `Pending` (and the pending index) with `description_hash`. Emitted by `register_action`, the first `approve` of an unknown id, `propose` and `propose_signer_change`.

events.name: proposal_created
events.state: Executor proposal `proposal_id` will call `target.function(args)` as the multisig once approved. Its `registered` event carries `description_hash == proposal_id`.

events.name: approved
events.state: `signer`'s approval of `action_id` is recorded (or refreshed) at `approved_at` in signer-set `epoch`. Fresh approvals now total `approval_count` / `approval_weight`; the action is approved while the weight is at least the threshold, the approvals are fresh and any `execute_by` hasn't passed.

events.name: revoked
events.state: `signer` withdrew their approval of `action_id`; fresh approvals now total `approval_count` / `approval_weight`.

events.name: reset
events.state: Action `action_id` moves to `Reset` (also for a vetoed signer change): approvals cleared, removed from the pending index.

events.name: expired
events.state: Action `action_id` moves to `Expired` because every approval went stale under the approval TTL: approvals cleared, removed from the pending index.

events.name: action_expired
events.state: Action `action_id` moves to `Expired` because its `execute_by` deadline passed: approvals cleared, removed from the pending index.

events.name: executed
events.state: Action `action_id` moves to `Executed` (an executor proposal ran, or a signer change applied): approvals cleared, removed from the pending index. It can never be approved again.

events.name: vetoed
events.state: The vetoer moved action `action_id` to `Vetoed`: approvals cleared, removed from the pending index, never approvable again.

events.name: vetoer_set
events.state: The one-time vetoer is now `vetoer` (immutable from here on).

events.name: execute_by_set
events.state: Action `action_id` stops counting as approved after `execute_by` (inclusive).

events.name: single_key_quorum
events.state: Warning, no state change: `signer`'s `weight` alone meets the approval `threshold` (emitted on initialize and on every rotation).

events.name: signer_change_proposed
events.state: Signer change `change_id` (`change`) is proposed in signer-set epoch `change.epoch`; it needs the rotation threshold, then `queue_signer_change` and the rotation delay.

events.name: signer_change_queued
events.state: Signer change `change_id` reached the rotation threshold; it becomes executable at `ready_at`.

events.name: signer_change_vetoed
events.state: `signer` killed signer change `change_id`: it moves to `Reset`, its approvals are cleared and it leaves the pending index.

events.name: signers_rotated
events.state: Signer change `change_id` applied: the signer set, threshold and rotation threshold are now as given, and the signer-set epoch is `epoch`, which voids every outstanding approval.

events.name: upgrade_approved
events.state: `signer` consents to upgrading the multisig to `wasm_hash`; `approvals` of `signer_count` signers have. At unanimity the hash is allowlisted (`upgrade_proposed`).

events.name: upgrade_revoked
events.state: `signer` withdrew consent to `wasm_hash` (now `approvals`); if it was allowlisted it no longer is (`upgrade_cancelled`).

events.name: initialized
events.state: The registry is live: `timelock` controls it, the registry version is 0 and the schema is `schema_version`.

events.name: param_defined
events.state: Creates parameter `key` with `value` inside `[min, max]`. The registry version becomes `version`.

events.name: param_updated
events.state: Parameter `key`'s value changes from `old_value` to `new_value` (bounds unchanged). The registry version becomes `version`.

events.name: bounds_proposed
events.state: Queues new bounds `[min, max]` for `key`, executable from `eta`. Replaces any pending proposal for `key`.

events.name: bounds_updated
events.state: Parameter `key`'s bounds become `[min, max]` and its pending proposal is cleared. The registry version becomes `version`.

events.name: bounds_cancelled
events.state: Parameter `key`'s pending bounds proposal (`[min, max]`, due `eta`) is dropped.

events.name: initialized
events.state: Staking is live: `stake_token` is staked, only `splitter` may notify rewards, unstakes wait `cooldown` seconds.

events.name: staked
events.state: `user` staked `amount`; their earning stake is now `stake` and the total `total_staked`. Accrual up to the current accumulator was settled first.

events.name: unstake_requested
events.state: `amount` of `user`'s stake stops earning; their earning stake is now `stake`, their pending unstake `pending`, withdrawable from `unlock_at` (restarted).

events.name: withdrawn
events.state: `user`'s whole pending unstake, `amount`, was paid out and cleared.

events.name: reward_notified
events.state: `amount` of `token` arrived. `RewardPerToken(token)` is now `reward_per_token`; `undistributed` is carried over if nothing was staked. A staker's accrual is `stake × Δreward_per_token / 1e18`.

events.name: carryover_distributed
events.state: Carried-over `token` rewards (`amount`) went to the first stake after an empty pool: `RewardPerToken(token)` is now `reward_per_token` and the carry is zero.

events.name: reward_claimed
events.state: `amount` of `token` accrued to `user` was paid out; their owed balance in `token` is zero.

events.name: initialized
events.state: Streams is live: `governance` may cancel any stream and run migrations.

events.name: stream_created
events.state: Creates stream `stream_id`, funded with `total` of `token` pulled from `funder`, streaming linearly to `recipient` from `start` to `end` with nothing withdrawable before `cliff`. Nothing is withdrawn yet.

events.name: withdrawn
events.state: `recipient` withdrew `amount`; the stream's cumulative withdrawn amount is now `withdrawn`.

events.name: stream_canceled
events.state: `caller` cancelled the stream: `to_recipient` went to the recipient and `to_funder` back to the funder. The stream is frozen with total and withdrawn both equal to `streamed`.

events.name: stream_transferred
events.state: The stream's recipient changes from `from` to `to`, accrued balance included.
